title: The Lavender New Year Closet Reset
description: A lavender New Year closet reset from Amazon: velvet hangers, lavender cube bins, a 3-shelf hanging organizer, clear magnetic shoe boxes, acrylic shelf dividers and gold clip-on labels.
intro: Last week I opened my closet to grab one sweater and an avalanche of jeans came with it. That was my sign. So the new year starts with a full closet reset, and I made it lavender because if I have to organize, it's going to be cute. Matching velvet hangers, cube bins with little gold labels, a hanging shelf for sweaters and clear boxes for the shoes I keep tripping over. It stays neat now. Mostly.

sections.heading: The hangers and the hanging shelf
paragraphs: The HOUSE DAY velvet hangers come 60 to a pack in a soft lilac, 17.5 in wide, and nothing slides off them. Swapping every mismatched hanger at once is the single most satisfying thing you can do to a closet. The GRANNY SAYS 3-shelf hanging organizer in purple hooks right over the rod and holds folded sweaters so they stop toppling off the shelf.

sections.heading: The bins and the labels
paragraphs: The GRANNY SAYS lavender cube bins are 11 in on every side and come in a 6 pack, so they fit cube shelves and closet shelves. Clip a gold label holder on the front of each one and write what's inside. Socks. Belts. Random cords. Done.

sections.heading: The shoes and the shelves
paragraphs: The clear shoe boxes have magnetic doors that drop down, and they stack, so the floor pile finally has somewhere to go. The HBlife clear acrylic shelf dividers (6 pack, about 7.5 in tall) keep stacks of jeans and sweaters standing up straight instead of slumping into each other.
